before_statement: The ring $R=k[x,y]_{(x,y)}$ and its completion $k[\![x,y]\!]$ both have dimension and embedding dimension two. For every $q\ge1$, their quotients by the $q$th powers of the maximal ideals agree and have basis the monomials of total degree less than $q$.
